name: Tregonsee
source:
Vice-leader of "The Six". A telepath.

Usually found in the private salon housing the Six preparing alcoholic drinks for Bågenholm, he uses his telepathic abilities to ensure no member of the Six is actively preparing to betray the group and supports the team by delivering precise instructions during combat.
